action_timeline.rationale: Opening lower hostiles must be dead; explicitly pass unfinished #4 to Lava.

battle_phases.completion_condition: By frame 2220, opening outer hostiles and #3 are dead; Midnight, Lancet and Melantha have completed their scheduled withdrawals.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A surviving outer hostile can leak during the empty interval; an early source death also invalidates later commands or DP-funded deployments.
battle_phases.goal: Survive all four opening hostile corridors and escape repeated lower artillery impacts.
handoff_requirements: Both opening lower hostiles must die before Midnight retreats; an injured survivor is not a completed interception duty.
Melantha must finish #3 before leaving; Midnight need not finish #4.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla jointly kill central opening runners while producing the grants needed by subsequent deployments.
Midnight uses second-61 arts to finish the lower officer; remaining #4 clearance belongs to Lava.
Melantha clears the upper opening and #3, using her second-70 skill if still required.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage starts with 10 DP and no operators deployed.
survival_dependencies: Lancet's treatment must leave Midnight healthy enough for exposure before frame 2115.
Earlier deployment changes target interactions; the prior frame-1980 impact is evidence of danger, not a guaranteed future clock.
Fang and Vanilla must survive to produce their budgeted grants.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Roadblock #1 is destroyed before Gallus leaves at frame 3330, and both medics remain active with Steward.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unfinished #1 leaves the first civilian detained during the western artillery return; medical collapse removes the primary artillery attacker.
battle_phases.goal: Open the upper western escape path while establishing durable eastern medical coverage.
handoff_requirements: Verify #1 destruction and the first civilian's complete arrival separately.
Beagle takes the upper outer corridor before the paired officers reach column 5.
responsibilities: Ansel and Hibiscus heal each other and the central formation before sustained eastern artillery exposure.
Steward begins continuous eastern artillery damage.
battle_phases.start_condition: Gallus deploys at frame 1410 while the opening continues.
survival_dependencies: Gallus must survive without baseline medical coverage.
Neither unsupported Gallus RES reduction nor medic talent multipliers are included.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Predict #4 destruction by frame 3420 and recorded artillery death by frame 4740.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A living artillery unit leaving eastern coverage threatens protected routes and can leak. Early Steward death is a failed survival responsibility, not permission to assume Lava completed the kill.
battle_phases.goal: Finish #4 and kill the artillery within its viable eastern damage window.
handoff_requirements: Cardigan must establish lower interception at frame 3720.
Lava's frame-4380 withdrawal follows the end of her lower-stop coverage, while Steward remains responsible for any surviving artillery.
responsibilities: Lava completes inherited #4 damage before nearby paired officers threaten the detained lower civilian.
Steward attacks across both eastern stops; Lava supplements the lower stop.
Both medics preserve the damage formation while central blockers retain passing hostiles.
battle_phases.start_condition: Lava deploys at frame 2820 facing UP.
survival_dependencies: Steward and both medics must remain alive; one artillery hit or partial accumulated damage is insufficient.
Outer officers can compete for Lava's attacks; no target ordering or splash multiplication is assumed.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Roadblock #2 is destroyed before frame 5160 and the second civilian subsequently reaches its objective safely.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unfinished #2 preserves civilian exposure even if the artillery is dead; losing Cardigan permits officers to reach the civilian or leak.
battle_phases.goal: Release the second civilian from its final obstacle under independent officer interception.
handoff_requirements: Check actual #2 destruction before treating Melantha's scheduled withdrawal as successful.
Record the second civilian's arrival; release alone does not satisfy the objective.
responsibilities: Melantha attacks #2 from [6,3] LEFT with ordinary physical damage.
Cardigan retains officers at [6,4], separating them from the civilian waiting farther west.
Beagle independently maintains the upper outer corridor.
battle_phases.start_condition: Lava withdraws and Melantha redeploys at frame 4380.
survival_dependencies: Melantha has completed redeployment cooldown and is not assigned unsupported healing or a second-deployment skill.
Cardigan must retain enough blocking capacity and HP throughout device clearance.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Melantha and Vanilla retreat in order; Midnight owns [4,5], Durin occupies [5,5], and all final spawns through frame 6330 remain contained.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An occupied-tile deployment failure leaves the lower central lane without its replacement; insufficient arts lets armored queues accumulate and overflow.
battle_phases.goal: Establish medically covered arts clearance without leaving a central lane unblocked.
handoff_requirements: Vanilla's RETREAT must precede Midnight's same-frame DEPLOY.
Keep both outer defenders; their final officers need not already be dead.
responsibilities: Midnight inherits lower central blocking and assists Fang.
Durin supplies continuous arts against both central queues.
Both medics maintain the central formation while Beagle and Cardigan retain outer queues.
survival_dependencies: Vanilla's retirement ends her economic contribution; later readiness does not rely on her grants.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Spawns exhausted, no active enemies, zero leaks, remaining_life > 0, zero protected-target deaths and both expected protected targets recorded safely arrived.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any leak, protected-target death, missing protected arrival or surviving enemy prevents project acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Finish every retained hostile and satisfy the complete project acceptance predicate.
handoff_requirements: Do not retreat units merely because the last spawn occurred.
Count protected arrivals independently of hostile kills and operator deaths.
responsibilities: Midnight uses arts at frames 6360 and, if battle continues, 9660.
Durin supplies continuous arts between Midnight windows.
Medics and all four corridor blockers remain until their duties are complete.
battle_phases.start_condition: The final modeled spawn occurs at frame 6330; retained enemies may remain.
survival_dependencies: Outer defenders must survive their full officer queues without unsupported self-healing.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward is the continuous artillery attacker under reciprocal medical support. Midnight may contribute during the opening crossing, and Lava contributes at the lower eastern stop. Require recorded artillery death before it escapes eastern coverage; do not credit particular target ordering.

Melantha clears #3 and the opening upper officer; Gallus clears #1. Beagle intercepts later officers at column 5. Record complete safe arrival of the first civilian, independently of roadblock destruction.

Midnight damages #4; Lava must finish it before the paired officers enter its vicinity. Cardigan holds at column 4 while Melantha clears #2 from column 3. Record the second civilian's complete safe arrival.
Fang retains upper central traffic. Vanilla initially assists; final Midnight and Durin provide sustained clearance, including armored enemies.
Vanilla retains lower central traffic until frame 5160; Midnight then inherits the same blocking position under both medics. Fang and Durin assist.
Melantha handles the opening; Beagle handles paired and final officers using ordinary three-block interception and attacks. Retain Beagle until her entire queue is dead.
Midnight must kill both opening hostiles before withdrawal; Cardigan handles paired and final officers. No unsupported self-healing is credited.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Permanent upper central blocker; assists the lower blocker and generates supported automatic DP.
Opening lower central blocker and reciprocal damage; explicitly yields this tile to Midnight at frame 5160.
Opening lower interception, partial roadblock #4 damage and early arts; leaves at frame 2115.
Opening upper interception and eastern roadblock #3 clearance.
Treat Midnight and Vanilla during the opening; withdraw before the previously observed artillery impact window.
Heal the central formation, Hibiscus and eastern damage operators.
Ordinary arts clearance of western upper roadblock #1 after the artillery's initial upper western stop.
Reciprocal medical coverage with Ansel; heal both central blockers and eastern damage operators.
Continuous primary artillery damage across the eastern vertical and both eastern stops; remains through final clearance.
Finish roadblock #4 without central-lane target competition, then attack the artillery's lower eastern stop.
Fresh upper outer interception, separated from civilians waiting at western roadblock #1.
Fresh lower outer interception; hold officers away from western roadblock #2.
Redeployed ordinary physical clearance of western lower roadblock #2 behind Cardigan.
After Vanilla explicitly retreats, inherit lower central blocking and attack both central blocking positions with repeatable arts.
Medically covered sustained arts damage into both central blocking positions.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward covers the eastern vertical continuously. Lava faces UP to inherit roadblock #4 and the lower eastern artillery stop; she does not cover the upper stop. Neither highest-defense targeting nor splash damage is credited.
formation_structure.medical: Ansel [2,6] UP and Hibiscus [5,6] DOWN mutually cover each other, both central blockers, Steward, Lava and the final Durin position. Outer interception and western clearance do not receive this baseline coverage.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla attack across adjacent central lanes. Midnight deploys at second 21, making arts available at second 61. Melantha deploys at second 30. Lancet supplies early treatment before withdrawing at second 65.
formation_structure.protected_routes: Upper clearance is Melantha on #3 followed by Gallus on #1. Lower clearance is Midnight's partial #4 work followed by Lava's completion, then redeployed Melantha on #2. Beagle at column 5 and Cardigan at column 4 prevent later officers from reaching western detention.
formation_structure.terminal: Fang, Midnight, both medics, Steward, Durin, Beagle and Cardigan remain. Midnight owns [4,5] only after Vanilla retreats. Durin supplies continuous arts between Midnight's active windows.

formation_transitions.transition: Withdraw Lancet before the previously observed frame-1980 impact. Midnight temporarily continues without local treatment; adequate remaining HP is a survival dependency.

Withdraw Midnight after the opening lower runner and officer are killed. Roadblock #4 is explicitly allowed to remain unfinished and passes to Lava. No lower outer hostile is scheduled again until second 116.
Withdraw Melantha after the upper opening hostiles and roadblock #3 are cleared. Her 70-second redeployment cooldown then completes before second 146.
Lava takes the vacant eastern high ground and inherits roadblock #4. Her UP range excludes central rows 3 and 4, reducing the competition seen in the failed Durin assignment.
Gallus withdraws after predicted roadblock #1 completion; Beagle occupies Melantha's already vacant upper ground tile before the paired officers arrive.
Cardigan establishes fresh lower interception before the first paired officer reaches [6,4]. Midnight's opening enemies must already be dead.
Lava's lower-stop coverage has ended; transfer her slot to Melantha for roadblock #2. This is a coverage-window handoff, not an assumed artillery-death gate. Steward and both medics remain.

Retreat Melantha after predicted roadblock #2 completion, then retreat Vanilla explicitly. Deploy Midnight on the now-free [4,5], followed by Durin on [5,5]. Blocking changes hands in the listed same-frame order.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator is in normal_low_star_catalog with identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true. Use only listed legal terrain and cardinal deployment directions.
Maximum simultaneous deployment is eight. At frame 5160, Vanilla must RETREAT before Midnight DEPLOY at [4,5]. Lava's earlier retreat alone does not free that tile.

Midnight must survive, kill both opening lower hostiles and withdraw at frame 2115. Lancet withdraws at 1950. The observed frame-1980 impact motivates this escape but is not asserted to be a universal targeting clock; an earlier lethal sequence refutes the opening.

Fang's first grants and Vanilla's first activation must actually occur. Delayed or absent grants caused by death are survival failures. No refunds, kill DP, unsupported talent DP or dead-operator grants fund this timeline.
Midnight's withdrawal does not assert #4 destruction. Lava explicitly inherits it. Predict #1 complete by 111, #3 by 74, #4 by 114 and #2 by 172; verify each independently.

Both medics and Steward must survive through the eastern damage window. Lava remains until 146, and Steward has no scheduled retreat. Early Steward death leaves insufficient demonstrated upper-stop coverage and refutes this candidate; do not manufacture a replacement or presumed kill.

Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Roadblock destruction releases their special restraint. Later officers must be intercepted away from western detention, and both complete arrivals must be recorded.
Fang, Midnight, Beagle and Cardigan retain their corridors through all final spawns and retained enemies. Both medics and Durin remain for clearance.

WIN requires remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns and no active enemies. Project acceptance additionally requires zero protected-target deaths and exactly two expected protected targets safely reaching their objectives. Operator deaths are recorded separately.

Timeline actions are fixed. Completion checks are predictions, not executable guards. A failed check invalidates its dependent handoff; Python must not reorder, skip, substitute or repair tactical actions.

pressure_window_responsibilities.responsibility: Establish reciprocal central damage and survival-dependent DP. Bring Midnight's arts forward to second 61, remove Lancet at 65 and Midnight at 70.5, and finish the upper opening before Melantha leaves.

Gallus clears #1 while both medics establish reciprocal coverage. Steward begins the primary artillery window. Lava inherits and finishes #4; her clearance deadline must precede nearby paired officers.
Establish fresh outer defenders, maintain eastern artillery output and verify the upper civilian's arrival. Lava's departure does not remove Steward's continuing responsibility.
Melantha clears #2 behind Cardigan, then yields her slot to terminal arts support. Verify the lower civilian's arrival and execute the explicit Vanilla-to-Midnight handoff.
Keep all four hostile corridors staffed through final runners, officers and armored spawns. Durin supplies immediate arts while Midnight charges.
Clear all retained enemies with continuous treatment, Durin and Midnight's arts windows. Keep outer defenders until their queues are empty and enforce the complete acceptance predicate.

skill_intents.intent: Automatic +6 DP is expected at seconds 19,44,69 and every 25 seconds thereafter while alive and deployed. Opening purchases depend on actual survival and grants.
Supported manual ATK and +6 DP at seconds 25,55,85,115,145; respect the 10-second active SP pause. No further grants are budgeted after her second-172 retreat.

Opening arts at second 61 accelerates the lower officer kill and remaining device or artillery attacks without assuming priority. Redeployment at 172 resets readiness to 212; the next activation is 322 after 40 active and 70 charging seconds.
ATK enhancement at second 70 finishes the opening upper duty. No skill is available during her short second deployment, so western #2 clearance relies on ordinary attacks.
Healing enhancement at seconds 69,129,189,249,309,369; include the 25-second active SP pause and exclude probabilistic extra healing.
Healing enhancement at seconds 88,138,188,238,288,338,388; include the 20-second active SP pause and exclude unsupported talent ATK.

Deployment grants supported 30 SP, making activation legal at second 104. Accelerate ordinary single-target arts to complete #4 and catch the beginning of the lower artillery stop; do not credit splash geometry.
DEF enhancement at second 151 provides a buffer against possible remaining artillery exposure. It is not credited as meaningful improvement against officers already near minimum physical damage.
Use supported automatic enhanced attacks. Do not assume highest-defense target priority or unsupported talent ATK.
Ordinary attacks and supported blocking only; exclude Gallus RES reduction, Durin evasion and Cardigan self-healing.

tactical_thesis: Advance Midnight's opening deployment and arts readiness, then withdraw the exposed lower support pair before repeated artillery impacts can destroy their handoff. Lava explicitly inherits unfinished eastern lower roadblock clearance before supplying lower-stop artillery damage. Mutually covered medics sustain Steward throughout the eastern artillery excursion. Gallus clears the upper western roadblock; redeployed Melantha replaces the inadequate Castle clearance assignment below. Fresh outer defenders separate officers from western civilian detention. Finally, explicitly retreat Vanilla before Midnight occupies [4,5], and add Durin for sustained central arts clearance. All completion times are falsifiable predictions, not assumed kills or executable conditional guards.
